The river bank looked quieter than usual that evening. There are always more possibilities than we expect. On Monday evenings, Amy reviews the notes from class. Also, audience participation makes the show fun.

People around Amy often share different ideas about the river bank. David always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Amy will take part in a volleyball match in July. Best of all, her breath made a soft exhalation cloud in the cold air.

Amy believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The butterfly bush lives up to its name.
The plant garden has become an important part of daily life. At first, Amy found it difficult to keep the habit. David advised Amy to try swimming as a new hobby. A circular announced the new rota.
The experience taught Amy more than any book could. Little by little, things began to change. Amy ordered soup and juice at the plant garden last night.
